Resolve an uncertain submission after confirming its outcome

Source: R/project_recovery.R
resolve_project_submission.Rd

Supply either the confirmed scheduler allocation ID or a rejection reason describing authoritative evidence that no job was accepted. Queue absence, elapsed time, and missing logs are not evidence of rejection. This is an explicit administrative recovery operation; it never guesses an outcome. Binding an allocation preserves any worker-reported status. Rejection is allowed only for UNKNOWN or SUBMITTING attempts with no bound job.

Usage

resolve_project_submission(
  input = getwd(),
  contract_id,
  scheduler_job_id = NULL,
  rejection_reason = NULL
)

Arguments

input

Project configuration, YAML file, or project directory.

contract_id

Exact UUID from inspect_project(input)$submissions.

scheduler_job_id

Confirmed root allocation ID in the recorded scheduler's format, or NULL. Slurm task IDs and diagnostic text are not allocation IDs; TORQUE element IDs are canonicalized to their array root.

rejection_reason

Evidence of confirmed rejection, or NULL.

Value

The resolved submission record, invisibly.

Details

There is no dry-run mode: this function updates the database immediately. Supply exactly one of scheduler_job_id and rejection_reason, for the exact recorded attempt. Binding does not verify outputs or authorize a duplicate launch. If acceptance cannot be confirmed or ruled out, leave the attempt unresolved and seek scheduler support. Do not delete tracking rows or move to a new output directory to bypass the submission guard.

After resolution, inspect the current state again. Correct confirmed rejection causes before repeating the intended run_project() request. An unbound attempt may have no tracked job for retry_project_run() to select.

See also

diagnose_project() for submission issues and reconcile_project_jobs() for known scheduler allocations. See vignette("diagnosing_pipeline", package = "BrainGnomes") for evidence requirements and the end-to-end recovery workflow.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
scfg <- load_project("/project/my_study")
diagnosis <- diagnose_project(scfg, interactive = FALSE)
diagnosis$submission_issues
contract_id <- "REPLACE_WITH_EXACT_CONTRACT_UUID"

# Only after confirming this exact attempt was accepted:
resolve_project_submission(scfg, contract_id, scheduler_job_id = "12345")
} # }
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Alternative to binding: only after authoritative confirmation of rejection.
# Do not run this after binding the same attempt above.
resolve_project_submission(scfg, contract_id,
  rejection_reason = "Administrator confirmed this exact request was rejected.")
} # }
